meta.title: Download Reports: Switch report type dropdown selection and download report

steps.note: Open the prepared awarded event as required for this state.
Navigate to the event's RFQ stage.
Open the RFQ Responses view specified by the case.
Verify that the Download Reports window opened.

args.goal: in the Download Reports window, open the report type dropdown, select an alternative report type if one is available, click Download Excel, and stop after the download action completes

steps.note: Handle the dynamic report type options and perform the requested download.
Verify that the download action produced a report file.
